capabilities: Convert pasted or dropped images to AVIF
Rename image files using a title and date template
Update wiki embeds and Markdown image links
Strip EXIF and XMP metadata from converted images
Shrink large images to a maximum size
extras: Requires Obsidian Desktop 1.13.0+ and ImageMagick 7 built with AVIF write support (and HEIC read support for HEIC files); suggests the IMEI installer for Debian/Ubuntu builds lacking those codecs. Runs entirely offline and never sends images over the network. Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted images in their original format with generic names, and there is no built-in way to convert them to AVIF or rename them automatically.

relations.evidence: AVIFicator converts images you paste or drop into Obsidian notes to AVIF with ImageMagick

summary: Image paste handler that converts images pasted or dropped into notes to AVIF via ImageMagick and renames them from a template.
